title: Analista de ti sênior (administrador de redes)
description:
Somos o maior ressegurador do Brasil. Com mais de 80 anos de experiência, atuamos nas principais linhas de negócios em resseguros e contamos com uma equipe altamente qualificada, pronta para inovar e oferecer os melhores produtos e serviços ao mercado.
Estamos com 1 vaga de Analista de TI Sênior, com foco em Administração de Redes . Confira os detalhes abaixo:
FORMAÇÃ O ACADÊ MICA

Necessário Superior completo em Engenharia de Redes, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
Certificações desejáveis: CCNA, CCNP, Fortinet NSE, Comp TIA Network+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Network Engineer Associate.
Desejável pós-graduação em Infraestrutura de TI, Segurança da Informação ou Engenharia de Conectividade.
EXPERIÊ NCIA/CONHECIMENTOS

Imprescindível experiência em administração e suporte de redes corporativas LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud;
Conhecimento avançado em roteamento, switching, firewalls, NAT, VLANs, Qo S e VPNs;
Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento e automação de rede (Zabbix, Solar Winds, PRTG, Ansible);
Experiência em ambientes híbridos e multicloud, com integração entre redes locais e provedores cloud;
Conhecimento de protocolos de rede (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, BGP, OSPF);
Familiaridade com segurança de rede, criptografia, IDS/IPS, segmentação e controle de acesso;
Capacidade de diagnóstico e troubleshooting de incidentes complexos de conectividade;
Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e regulados, com requisitos de alta disponibilidade e compliance;
Familiaridade com soluções de rede e segurança Cisco, Palo Alto e Trend Micro;
Necessário Inglês técnico intermediário (para leitura de documentação e interface com fornecedores globais).
MISSÃ O DA POSIÇÃ O
Garantir a operação estável, segura e eficiente das redes de comunicação de dados e voz do IRB(Re), assegurando disponibilidade, desempenho e confiabilidade dos serviços de conectividade corporativa. É o responsável técnico pela infraestrutura de rede, abrangendo LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls e equipamentos de comunicação, suportando as operações do negócio e garantindo conformidade com as políticas de segurança e governança de TI.
Assegurar a continuidade e a resiliência das redes corporativas, promovendo padronização, automação e melhoria contínua da infraestrutura de conectividade que sustenta os sistemas críticos e o ambiente híbrido do IRB(Re).
PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES
Gestão e Operação de Ambientes
Administrar e monitorar a rede corporativa LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud, garantindo disponibilidade, estabilidade e desempenho;
Configurar, manter e otimizar switches, roteadores, access points, firewalls, balanceadores e VPNs;
Monitorar a latência, throughput e integridade dos enlaces de rede, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
Executar rotinas de backup e restauração de configurações de rede;
Gerenciar e documentar o inventário de equipamentos de rede, seus contratos de manutenção;
Apoiar times de Service Desk e Infraestrutura na resolução de incidentes relacionados à conectividade;
Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de disponibilidade e performance de rede, com reportes regulares à Governança de TI.
Implementação e Melhoria Contínua
Planejar e executar projetos de implantação, atualização e expansão de rede, em alinhamento com Engenharia & Plataforma;
Definição de escopo técnico para projetos de infraestrutura de redes, visando escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade dos serviços, garantindo o alinhamento entre requisitos técnicos e necessidades de negócio;
Avaliar novas tecnologias e padrões de conectividade (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi 6, 5 G, Zero Trust Network Access);
Automatizar tarefas de configuração e monitoração com uso de ferramentas de gerenciamento de rede e scripts (Ansible, Python, SNMP, etc.);
Apoiar a integração de ambientes on-premises e cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) garantindo conectividade segura;
Participar da definição de arquiteturas de rede resilientes e escaláveis, em conjunto com Arquitetura Corporativa;
Documentar diagramas, topologias e fluxos de rede no repositório corporativo de arquitetura;
Realizar testes de carga, failover e redundância em enlaces críticos.
Segurança, Governança e Compliance
Operar e gerenciar ferramentas de segurança, como: Endpoint Security, NGFW, PAM, WAF, Cloud Email Security, NAC, DNS Security, de acordo as diretrizes do CISO;
Monitorar e responder a alertas de segurança de rede, incidentes e vulnerabilidades, em colaboração com o time de Cyber Service;
Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de controles e conformidade (LGPD, SUSEP, SOX);
Assegurar a execução de atualizações de firmware e patches de segurança nos dispositivos de rede;
Gerenciar logs e trilhas de auditoria de equipamentos e soluções de rede;
Apoiar o planejamento e execução de planos de continuidade e recuperação de desastres (DRP) para infraestrutura de rede.

El rol de Ejecutivo Comercial ofrece una oportunidad emocionante para impulsar el crecimiento empresarial, expandir la presencia de OYO en mercados clave y contribuir al éxito de nuestra organización. Si eres una persona motivada y emprendedora con pasión por el desarrollo de negocios y la hospitalidad, te invitamos a unirte a nuestro equipo y ayudarnos a construir la marca más confiable del mundo.
Brief Job Description
As a Commercial Executive , you will play a pivotal role in driving business growth by identifying and engaging with potential business partners to expand OYO's presence in key markets. You will be responsible for developing and executing strategies to attract new properties, negotiate agreements, and drive adoption of the OYO OS model. Additionally, you will work closely with property owners to understand their needs, provide ongoing support, and ensure a seamless onboarding process.
Como Ejecutivo Comercial, jugarás un papel crucial en el impulso del crecimiento empresarial identificando y comprometiéndote con socios comerciales potenciales para expandir la presencia de OYO en mercados clave. Serás responsable de desarrollar y ejecutar estrategias para atraer nuevas propiedades, negociar acuerdos e impulsar la adopción del modelo OYO OS. Además, trabajarás estrechamente con los propietarios de propiedades para comprender sus necesidades, proporcionar apoyo continuo y asegurar un proceso de integración fluido.
Job Overview
The Commercial Executive will be primarily focused on business development initiatives, including prospecting, lead generation, and partnership building. You will leverage your strong communication and negotiation skills to cultivate relationships with property owners, drive adoption of OYO's products and services, and maximize revenue opportunities. In addition to expanding our network of properties, you will also collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement strategies to optimize the performance of existing properties.
El Ejecutivo Comercial se centrará en el desarrollo de negocios, incluyendo la prospección, generación de leads y construcción de asociaciones. Utilizarás tus fuertes habilidades de comunicación y negociación para cultivar relaciones con los propietarios de propiedades, impulsar la adopción de los productos y servicios de OYO y maximizar las oportunidades de ingresos. Además de expandir nuestra red de propiedades, también colaborarás con equipos internos para desarrollar e implementar estrategias que optimicen el rendimiento de las propiedades existentes.
Responsibilities
Identify, pursue, and move leads through the sales cycle to expand OYO's network of properties in target markets.
Develop and execute strategic business development plans to achieve growth objectives.
Negotiate agreements with property owners to onboard new properties onto the OYO platform.
Meet with customers/clients face to face & or over the phone.
Developing proposals for clients.
Provide ongoing support to property owners, including assistance with onboarding, training, and troubleshooting.
Collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement strategies to optimize property performance and drive revenue growth.
Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities for expansion and differentiation.
Coordinate pricing strategies with Revenue Managers
Ensure room availability (for selling) for the company.
Recovery of debt.
Churn prevention: Engage with partners to educate them around the solutions Oyo provides and reduce churn.
Partner Experience: Ensuring our partners are looked after is critical and so this role is responsible in supporting post onboarding to ensure brand standards, recon statements, commercial understanding (if any) and act as a support function for the partner.
Identificar, perseguir y avanzar leads a través del ciclo de ventas para expandir la red de propiedades de OYO en mercados objetivo.
Desarrollar y ejecutar planes estratégicos de desarrollo de negocio para alcanzar objetivos de crecimiento.
Negociar acuerdos con propietarios de propiedades para integrar nuevas propiedades a la plataforma OYO.
Reunirse con clientes cara a cara o por teléfono.
Desarrollar propuestas para clientes.
Proporcionar apoyo continuo a los propietarios de propiedades, incluyendo asistencia con la integración, capacitación y solución de problemas.
Colaborar con equipos internos para desarrollar e implementar estrategias que optimicen el rendimiento de las propiedades y fomenten el crecimiento de ingresos.
Monitorear las tendencias del mercado y la actividad de los competidores para identificar oportunidades de expansión y diferenciación.
Coordinar estrategias de precios con los Gerentes de Ingresos.
Asegurar la disponibilidad de habitaciones (para venta) para la empresa.
Recuperación de deudas.
Prevención de deserción: Interactuar con socios para educarlos sobre las soluciones que OYO ofrece y reducir la deserción.
Experiencia del Socio: Asegurar el bienestar de nuestros socios es crítico y, por tanto, este rol es responsable de apoyar después de la integración para asegurar estándares de marca, entendimientos comerciales y actuar como función de apoyo para el socio.
Job Experience
2-3 years of relevant experience in business development, sales, or related fields, preferably in Real Estate and Hospitality industries.
2-3 años de experiencia relevante en desarrollo de negocios, ventas o campos relacionados, preferiblemente en las industrias de Bienes Raíces y Hospitalidad.
Education
Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas, Gestión Hotelera o campo relación
Language
Fluent in English (both verbal and written).
Inglés Fluido. Las entrevistas serán realizadas en Inglés.
Skills and qualifications
Drive and self-motivation.
Networking ability
Strong business development skills, with a proven track record of identifying and closing new business opportunities.
Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders.
Strategic thinker with the ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and develop actionable plans to drive growth.
Results-oriented mindset with a focus on achieving targets and delivering measurable results.
Highly organized with strong project management skills and the ability to prioritize and multitask effectively.
Automotivación.
Capacidad de establecer redes de contacto.
Fuertes habilidades de desarrollo de negocio con un historial probado de identificación y cierre de nuevas oportunidades de negocio.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y negociación con la capacidad de construir y mantener relaciones con partes interesadas clave.
Pensador estratégico con la habilidad de analizar tendencias del mercado, identificar oportunidades y desarrollar planes de acción para impulsar el crecimiento.
Mentalidad orientada a resultados, con un enfoque en alcanzar objetivos y entregar resultados medibles.
Altamente organizado con fuertes habilidades de gestión de proyectos y la capacidad de priorizar y manejar múltiples tareas eficazmente.

title: Supervisor de almoxarifado
description:
Descrição das atividades:
Controlar a entrada e saída de materiais no almoxarifado, manter controle do estoque mínimo, registrar movimentações em planilha na rede, a fim de garantir a disponibilidade de materiais necessários para eventuais emergências.
Manter registro de ferramentas de todos os colaboradores do setor e auditar periodicamente sem aviso prévio, para assegurar o controle, integridade e uso correto das ferramentas.
Solicitar pedido de compra mensal de materiais e ferramentas para reposição de estoque e reformas, através de controle do estoque e lista de matérias efetuadas e aprovadas para as reformas, para garantir disponibilidade de materiais necessários para a rotina de manutenção e reformas.
Organizar logística de ferramentas e materiais para as atividades diárias, através de planejamento verificar locais de atividades e materiais separados pelos colaboradores, para assegurar que as atividades sejam executadas com mínimo de perdas em deslocamento.
Efetuar inventários cíclicos e inventário geral das peças em estoque periodicamente, por meio da verificação física de cada item do almoxarifado, para que os registros do sistema estejam atualizados com físico.
Conferir notas fiscais dos materiais entregues e enviar para setor de compras, exigir ao fornecedor antes de receber os materiais a nota fiscal e após a conferência enviar em PDF ao setor de Compras, para controle de custos da manutenção.
Especificar e solicitar cadastros de novos materiais, consultando catálogos técnicos e fornecedores, preenchendo formulário e enviando para o setor de cadastro, para produtos não cadastrados e redução de custos com novos materiais.
Zelar pelos equipamentos de sua responsabilidade, efetuando limpeza após o uso, a fim de manter as regras de 5s, a fim de manter o ambiente saudável e seguro.
Zelar pela segurança na realização das atividades, utilizando os maquinários e ferramentas apropriadas para cada atividade, além dos EPI’s, para minimizar de riscos e prevenir acidentes de trabalho.
Treinar e orientar os almoxarifes da sua equipe.

Experiência da área mínima de 5 anos;
Formação acadêmica em Logística e/ou áreas correlatas;
CNH B;
Pacote Office - intermediário;
Vivência com software de estoque.
Diferenciais:
Conhecimento software de programação TOTVS Protheus;
Facilidade com tecnologias e inovações;
Gostar de padronização.

Segunda à sexta-feira - 8h às 17:48 (Joá, Barra da Tijuca | 100% presencial)
Remuneração:
Contratação CLT - Enviar pretensão salarial.

title: Assembly and after-sales support technician
description:
Job Description
Job Title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician
Location: Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required
Reports to: Account Manager and CTO
Contract Type: CLT
About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.
Position Summary:
The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.
Position duties and responsibilities:
Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.
Qualification and requirements:
Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting. Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
Strong problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.
Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.
LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.
Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps: Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician . Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English . Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps.
Interview Process: Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

title: Junior sales closer (consultor de vendas)
description:
Localização:  Barra da Tijuca, RJ
Tipo de vaga: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica), tempo integral,  R$ 6.000,00 fixo + comissões ilimitadas  
Sobre a Ótima Energia Não somos apenas mais uma corretora de energia empurrando uma única solução. Na Ótima Energia, existimos para trazer clareza e confiança a um mercado confuso. As empresas brasileiras pagam caro pela energia não porque faltam opções, mas porque o mercado é barulhento: ofertas confusas, contratos ambíguos e vendedores empurrando o que paga a melhor comissão para eles.
Nós substituímos isso por uma abordagem neutra e baseada em dados. Nosso sistema de IA, o ECOS™, analisa os três mercados de energia (ACR, ACL, GDL) e diz às empresas exatamente onde elas economizarão mais, com zero conflito de interesses.
Nossa promessa:  Sua energia. Sua escolha. Sua economia.  Estamos crescendo rápido. E precisamos de pessoas que amam vencer.
A Função: Closer (Consultor de Energia) Este não é um trabalho para quem precisa que as coisas sejam fáceis. Este é um lugar para quem:
É um talento de alto potencial finalmente pronto para ser liberado.
Tem habilidade comprovada e busca o palco à altura da sua ambição.
Sabe o que é ralar e quer ralar por algo real.
Faz as pessoas se sentirem bem apenas por estarem no mesmo ambiente.
É um doador de energia, não um sugador.
Este Trabalho NÃO É Para Você Se:
Você trata a empatia como uma tática em vez de um traço de personalidade.
Você fala muito, mas tem zero disciplina para sustentar o que diz.
Você é uma "pessoa de pessoas", mas desmorona ao ser rejeitado.
Você ama o holofote, mas odeia a disciplina necessária para se manter nele.
Você está esperando por um "golpe de sorte" em vez de trabalhar mais que todos na sala.
Você tem "100% de potencial", mas só entrega 50% de esforço quando ninguém está olhando.
Quem Você É
Qualidade Por que isso importa
Você ama vencer | Fechar negócios traz uma sensação imbatível. Você é competitivo e acompanha seu placar.
Você é mentalmente forte | A rejeição não te abala. Você sabe que o "não" é apenas um número no caminho para o "sim".
Você é implacável | Você faz 60 ligações. Depois 80. Depois 100. Você não para até o trabalho estar feito.
Um charme natural | As pessoas genuinamente gostam de falar com você. Você cria conexão em segundos.
Esforço gera recompensa | Você entende que, aqui, resultados = recompensas financeiras.
Treinável, não robótico | Você domina o processo e o script, e depois os torna seus.
Disseram que você não seria capaz | E você ainda está aqui. Pronto para provar que estavam errados.
Fala Inglês | Básico ao avançado — o suficiente para entender documentos e falar com nosso fundador.
O Que Você Fará
Fazer de 60 a 100 ligações por dia para leads qualificados.
Ter conversas reais sobre economia de energia.
Explicar nossa abordagem neutra e sem conflito de interesses.
Lidar com objeções. Superar o "não tenho interesse". Transformar "talvez" em "sim".
Fechar negócios. E depois fechar mais.
Este é um jogo de volume. Os melhores closers fazem o maior número de ligações. É matemática pura.
O Dinheiro (É Bom)
Métrica | O que significa
Base Fixa | R$ 6.000,00 mensais.  Estabilidade garantida enquanto você constrói.
Comissão por negócio | Generosa. Sem teto. Receba pelo seu desempenho.
OTE (Ganho Estimado) | Profissionais de alto desempenho superam  R$ 12.000,00+  por mês.
Sem Limites | Não travamos sua comissão. Quanto mais você vende, mais você ganha.
O Pacote Contrato PJ: Você trabalha como pessoa jurídica. Simples, direto e profissional. Equipamento: Fornecemos laptop + toda a tecnologia necessária. Sem custo para você. Ferramentas: Zoho, Portal, sistema de leads — tudo configurado e pronto. Treinamento: Completo sobre o mercado de energia, nosso processo e ferramentas. Suporte: Você nunca será deixado sozinho para "dar um jeito".
Por Que Se Juntar a Nós Ganhos ilimitados: Sua renda é limitada apenas pelo seu esforço e habilidade. Oportunidade massiva: Milhares de leads qualificados esperando para serem chamados. Produto real: Nós realmente ajudamos donos de empresas a economizar dinheiro. Sem microgerenciamento: Confiamos no seu trabalho duro. Seus resultados falam por si. Potencial de crescimento: Quem performa vira líder de equipe, gerente e depois diretor. Um lugar para os subestimados: Se já duvidaram de você antes, você vai se sentir em casa aqui. Uso do Inglês: Sua habilidade no idioma é um trunfo real aqui.
Choque de Realidade Este trabalho não é para todos. Você ouvirá "não" muito mais do que ouvirá "sim". Você fará ligações mesmo quando não estiver com vontade. Você passará por cima da rejeição e continuará em frente.
Mas, se você vencer, você vence grande.  Os melhores closers aqui ganharão mais do que muitos gerentes. Eles terão liberdade, respeito e um plano de carreira.
﻿ Como Se Candidatar Não queremos currículos. Queremos ver você. Grave um vídeo de 30 segundos respondendo:
Quem é você? 2. Por que você? Pode ser em português. Apenas seja você mesmo. 30 segundos. Sem roteiro. Sem edições. Apenas você. Envie para: ⚠️ IMPORTANTE: Candidaturas sem vídeo NÃO serão consideradas. Este trabalho é sobre falar com pessoas. Se você não consegue falar conosco por 30 segundos, não conseguirá falar com 100 clientes por dia. Vídeo ou nada. Uma Última Coisa:  Não precisamos de especialistas em energia. Precisamos de pessoas disciplinadas, apaixonadas e que se importam com tudo o que fazem. O resto, nós ensinamos. Ótima Energia   Construída por pessoas que não deveriam estar aqui.

title: Engenheiro(a) de serviços - rj
description:
Resumo do cargo:
Proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.
Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:
1) Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sistemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);
2) Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
3) Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
4) Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
6) Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
7) Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
8) Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, assim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
9) Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.
Quem você é:
Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.
Para este cargo, você precisará:
Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, Versa Max, Quick Panel+, Machine Edition e etc;
Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.
Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:
Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

description:

Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.

Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
Documentation & Reporting

Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.

Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.Skills & Qualifications:Technical Expertise:
Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, mac OS, Linux) and common software applications.
Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
Problem-solving Ability:
An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
Communication Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
Organizational Skills:
Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.Preferred Experience:Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, i OS).
Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
Previous work with an American company
Education & Certifications:Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern Saa S platforms.Who You Are:
A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
Passion for helping others internally and externally
Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
In addition, we give bonus points for having a Saa S or Ecommerce background!

title: Support specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub.Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: ). Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!About the opportunity
As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.
﻿ This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew.We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?Key Responsibilities:Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
Customer Support
Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
Documentation & Reporting
Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
Escalation Management
Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.Skills & Qualifications:Technical Expertise:
Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, mac OS, Linux) and common software applications.
Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
Problem-solving Ability:
An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
Communication Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
Organizational Skills:
Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.Preferred Experience:Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, i OS).
Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
Previous work with an American company
Education & Certifications:Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern Saa S platforms.Who You Are:
A solid technical aptitude- we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
Passion for helping others internally and externally
Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
In addition, we give bonus points for having a Saa S or Ecommerce background!

title: Risk management officer
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
Net-worth monitoring.
Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years)in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
Demonstratedindependence from commercial functionsand ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
Strong knowledge ofCentral Bank of Brazilrisk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
Must meetfit and properstandards withno disqualifying factors , including:
not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.

Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.

Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Cloud Solutions Architect - Alliances
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Cloud Solutions Architect in our Alliances team to help our biggest partners (companies like Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.

Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.

We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. You will support various alliances and partners of Canonical to adopt our products and technologies, help business leaders to define joint go-to-market programs with partners from the technical standpoint.

We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.

Location : This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.

What your day will look like

  • Understand Ubuntu, Linux, networking and services in real-world environments
  • Architect cloud infrastructure solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, OpenStack, Ceph, and Spark either On-Premises or in Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Architect and integrate popular open source software such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Cassandra and NGINX
  • Help partners to offer and architect joint solutions utilizing Canonical's technologies on top of the public clouds and in the data center
  • Design and publish joint Reference Architectures and perform technical validations with various partners
  • Prepare and run onboarding sessions/workshops with various partners' teams to promote Canonical products and solutions

If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, cloud-native development, data center technologies such as Kubernetes and computer networking, you will love the Alliances Architect role at Canonical.

What we are looking for in you

  • Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds
  • Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments
  • Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs
  • Interest in new technologies like LXD, Juju and Snaps
  • Ability to travel globally up to 30% of the time
  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related technical field experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

  • the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  • the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament.
  • efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Implement the Competitions project, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management
  • Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services
  • Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment
  • Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)
  • Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary
  • Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners
  • Oversee the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;
  • Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil
  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.
  • Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team
  • Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements;
    • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines;
    • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities;
    • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties;
    • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required;
    • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops.
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC
  • Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich;
    • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management;
    • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
    • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
    • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC

YOUR PROFILE

  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The position

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services will work together with the Team Services and Competition Management Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  1. the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  2. the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament.
  3. efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament.

Key responsibilities

  • Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Implement the Competitions projec, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management
  • Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services
  • Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment
  • Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)
  • Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary
  • Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners
  • Overseeing the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;
  • Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil
  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.
  • Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team
  • Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements;
    • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines;
    • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities;
    • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties;
    • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required;
    • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops.
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams – in the lead-up to the FWWC
  • Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich;
    • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management;
    • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
    • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
    • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams – in the lead-up to the FWWC

Your profile

  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Sobre o Banco de Talentos

A BigDataCorp tem a missão de democratizar o acesso aos dados. Nós temos sede por crescimento e inovação, e queremos ser a maior datatechplataforma de dados do mundo. Estamos sempre em evolução e crescimento, por isso, novas posições dentro da BigDataCorp são constantemente necessárias.

Sobre a área e a vaga

O time de Infraestrutura é responsável por organizar, manter e evoluir as diferentes plataformas que constituem a base da operação da empresa. Da organização dos serviços de computação na nuvem à segurança da informação. Estamos à procura de um Especialista DevOps apaixonado por tecnologia para integrar a nossa equipe de TI. Se você é especialista em implementar, gerenciar e aprimorar práticas de DevOps, contribuindo para a entrega contínua de software e eficiência operacional, queremos te conhecer.

Requirements

O que vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Configurar e gerenciar ambientes de infraestrutura na AWS, com foco em AWS ECS e AWS EKS;
  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura como código (laC) usando Terraform;
  • Implementar e gerenciar pipelines de integração contínua / entrega contínua (CI / CD) no Gitlab;
  • Realizar monitoramento, escalabilidade e automação de processos de implantação;
  • Garantir a segurança e a conformidade das práticas de DevOps;
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para otimizar a entrega de software;
  • Manter ferramentas de análise de código e de segurança integradas com a pipeline, como Sonarqube e ZapProxy;
  • Manter documentação técnica detalhada e compartilhar conhecimento com a equipe;
  • Participar na configuração e gerenciamento de recursos em ambientes AWS;
  • Organizations, AWS Control Tower e AWS IAM Identity Center.

Habilidades necessárias

  • Experiência comprovada como DevOps em um ambiente de TI, com ênfase em AWS ECS e AWS EKS;

title: Senior Media Operations Manager
description:
Senior Media Operations Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Operations at all stadiums in Brazil for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Media Operations is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Operations Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Venue Management, Team Services, Competition Management, Media Partnerships, Host Broadcast Operations, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media operations for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women’s World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy .

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and deliver consistent media-dedicated spaces and flows, in all of competition venues in collaboration with other key functional areas.
  • Define strategic implementation of Media Operations & Services in collaboration with the Services manager in each host city based on unique availability of resources.
  • Support the planning and implementation of all corporate media activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • Ensure media areas at the competition venues are set up to the highest possible industry standards and are ready to be operational within the agreed timeframe ahead of the start of the tournament.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Senior Media Services Manager to define space requirements for International News Agency representatives at competition venues.
  • Event-time coordination and management of the Venue Media Managers team in the stadiums. Set up regular meetings and workshops with the Venue Media Managers of the stadiums.
  • Plan and train the media volunteers together with the venue managers.
  • Support engagement with local and international media to define requirements and ensure the delivery of operations is set to the highest standards.
  • Implementation of the Camera Loan & repair facilities and any new service.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part-time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally

Overview

The Dean is a cornerstone of Crimson Global Academy, driving student and staff success through strategic oversight of academic programs and meaningful stakeholder collaboration. Working collaboratively with the Deputy Principal, other deans, principals, and the Head of School, you will support the effective operation and continuous improvement of school programs while ensuring the vision and integrity of the US Diploma Program remains central as it continues to serve students globally. This Dean will support curriculum alignment, maintenance, and development aligned with CGA initiatives, while providing essential support to teachers and students across all learning modes.

This role serves as a key operational partner to the Deputy Principal, providing direct support for group class instruction, student services, and day-to-day academic operations. The Dean helps ensure the Deputy Principal can focus on strategic initiatives and complex problem-solving by managing core responsibilities, including homeroom programs, student check-ins, faculty communication, and curriculum documentation.

The ideal candidate combines operational excellence with forward-thinking innovation – someone who understands the nuances of online education while possessing the vision to help shape CGA as an educational institution of the future. Your ability to communicate effectively across time zones, solve complex problems, maintain a global perspective, collaborate across departments, and execute with precision will be essential to your success.

Key Responsibilities

1. Student Success & Community Building

  • Support the Deputy Principal in ensuring comprehensive student services and engagement across all learning modes
  • Attend and support student processes and school-wide assemblies
  • Support and promote student participation in extracurricular activities
  • Support and mentor student leaders in their roles and initiatives, coordinating with the Deputy Principal on NHS and club activities
  • Attend and contribute to ceremonies that celebrate student achievements and student recognition programs
  • Support implementation of best practices in online high school community engagement
  • Proactively monitor student attendance and academic performance, implementing intervention strategies when necessary and escalating complex cases to the Deputy Principal
  • Conduct regular student check‑ins to identify challenges and provide timely support, serving as a first point of contact before escalation
  • Lead student homeroom programs across all sections to ensure consistent quality
  • Support students across all three learning modes: CGA Group, Da Vinci, and Flex Courses
  • Assist the Deputy Principal with student wellbeing programs and family communications

2. Faculty Development & Curriculum Support

  • Collaborate with the Deputy Principal, principals, other deans, and school leadership on policy development, implementation, and review
  • Support group class teachers in delivering high‑quality instruction across all courses, assisting the Deputy Principal with teacher observations and feedback
  • Lead curriculum alignment, maintenance, and creation initiatives to ensure consistency with CGA standards and educational goals, supporting the Deputy Principal's oversight of academic programs
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive curriculum review cycle to continuously enhance educational offerings
  • Create curriculum mapping documentation to ensure vertical and horizontal alignment across grade levels and subjects, supporting the Deputy Principal's curriculum oversight responsibilities
  • Establish and maintain curriculum standards that reflect both US diploma requirements and global best practices
  • Design and implement assessment strategies that align with curriculum objectives and measure student achievement effectively
  • Identify and secure US pathway‑specific resources to enhance curriculum delivery
  • Work closely with department heads and group class teachers to ensure course alignment, promote best practices in online teaching, and maintain consistent staff communication
  • Facilitate professional development opportunities for teachers across all learning modes, supporting the Deputy Principal's staff development initiatives
  • Participate in monthly staff briefings and contribute to teacher training focused on online pedagogy
  • Provide day‑to‑day support for group class instructors, allowing the Deputy Principal to focus on strategic instructional leadership

3. Operational Excellence & Administrative Support

  • Partner with the Deputy Principal and leadership team on policy development, implementation, and periodic review
  • Support the Deputy Principal with calendar management and timetabling coordination, ensuring timely communication of important dates to all stakeholders
  • Assist with schedule changes and resolve minor conflicts, escalating complex issues to the Deputy Principal
  • Coordinate effectively across multiple time zones to support CGA's global student body
  • Support in maintaining organized student records and documentation in the student information system, ensuring data accuracy and clarity
  • Monitor and help approve students through the Enrollment Improvement Channel, working collaboratively with Admissions Officers and the Deputy Principal
  • Apply strong knowledge of the US diploma system and transfer credit policy to support student academic planning and course placement decisions
  • Review and evaluate transfer credits in accordance with school policy, escalating complex cases to the Deputy Principal as needed
  • Assist with communications to students, parents, and staff regarding academic programs, policies, and diploma requirements
  • Support AP course coordination and College Board requirements as needed
  • Take on additional responsibilities as reasonably requested by Crimson Global Academy
  • Maintain and update staff and student‑facing documentation to ensure accuracy and relevance
  • Support coordination and consistency across CGA Group, Da Vinci, and Flex Courses learning modes
  • Assist the Deputy Principal with admissions support activities, including academic planning discussions and information sessions
  • Help manage day‑to‑day operational tasks, enabling the Deputy Principal to focus on strategic problem‑solving and complex challenges

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of professional experience in education, with demonstrated success in student and curriculum support
  • Strong understanding of the US diploma system, graduation requirements, and transcript management
  • Knowledge of transfer credit evaluation and policy application
  • Proven experience in remote work environments and ability to work effectively across multiple time zones
  • Demonstrated skill in education program development and execution
  • Experience supporting group class instruction and teacher development
  • Understanding of differentiated instruction and learning accommodations
  • Experience with student information systems and maintaining accurate academic records
  • Counseling experience or qualification (preferred)
  • Exceptional attention to detail with strong task prioritization abilities
  • Adaptable mindset with capacity to pivot quickly in response to changing needs
  • Self‑directed work style with ability to execute independently while maintaining alignment with institutional goals
  • Strong collaborative skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across leadership levels, particularly in supporting the Deputy Principal's strategic initiatives
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills to support operational efficiency
  • Passion for educational innovation and willingness to initiate self‑driven projects that advance the school's mission

About Crimson Global Academy

Crimson Global Academy is a premier online high school delivering world‑class education through innovative digital platforms. Our US Diploma Program provides students around the world with a rigorous academic experience that prepares them for success at top universities globally, offered through three distinct learning modes: CGA Group, Da Vinci, and Flex Courses.
